heading: FAQ’s on Fantasy Sports App Development Solutions

items.question: Does the app use live sports data?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate with live sports data providers for real-time scoring.

items.question: How are payments handled?
items.answer: Wallets and payment gateways handle deposits and withdrawals securely.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks, depending on customisation.

items.question: Is it compliant with local laws?
items.answer: We build to your requirements; legal compliance depends on your market and licences.

items.question: Can I add multiple sports?
items.answer: Yes. Multiple sports and formats are supported.

items.question: How much does a fantasy sports app cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on features and data providers. Share your requirements for an estimate.
